text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Valentino-san, Tinetino-san, Master Bream 
Fisher Chino-san...! 
Please reveal unto me the ultimate 
Valentine's menu... Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see, so this is the menu! 
In that case, the ingredients are...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Suzuka-san! Have you decided on your 
ingredients as well?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I managed to gather some good stuff. 
I think Taiki and Fukukitaru will be happy 
with this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nyuhuhu~! It was well worth traveling far 
and wide for ingredient shopping, then! 
Now then, with this――

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Suzuka-san, what's wrong? 
You seem to have a rather gloomy look on 
your face...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! Ah, no... 
It's not really anything like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However... the "orbit" toward the 
"connect." 
That is――Neo Universe is also in a state 
of "trouble."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe also――wishes to "use" this 
place.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san...?! Wh-What is with all this 
luggage?! 
There's a massive pile even outside the 
kitchen...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Could all of this possibly be... 
ingredients for sweets...?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――Neo Universe has reached the "answer." 
Whether it is the correct "coordinate"――is 
unknown.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However――the "OVWL" of "feelings"... 
can only be "expressed" as they are...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Executing... Project Chocolate-Monolith.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How wondrous. Tonight, the violin's timbre 
is exceptionally beautiful―― 
As though blessing a wonderful destino――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Universe-san! What a pleasant 
coincidence. 
It's a night sky reminiscent of the very 
moment we first met.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That large parcel behind you is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth. 
...This is――Neo Universe's "feelings."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Th-This chocolate... Depicted on its 
surface is 
me playing music, me running... and me, 
conversing with you, Universe-san...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds of Earth. 
Neo Universe... "knows."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth. You have been running... 
to create a "session." 
To create a "resonance."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe has constantly "observed" 
the way Sounds of Earth "tries her best."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Unable to win. Unrewarded. ...Those 
outcomes 
have "never once" disturbed Sounds of 
Earth's "harmony."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To such a Sounds of Earth... Neo Universe 
sincerely "presents" this. 
...A 'keep on trying.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ............Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...The melodia emanating from this 
monolith is―― 
neither merely cheerful, nor solely 
bringing wild passion...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Quietly, gently, and warmly. Like a 
gentle push on my back— 
Yes... like the 'Off you go' I heard so 
long ago, in my childhood."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah. How can I even describe the emotion 
welling up in my chest right now...! 
So simple, yet... so incomparably 
powerful, this feeling is—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Yes...! I... 'want to do my best'!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Now, my resolve has been renewed. 
I'll do it. I'll see it through to the 
very end!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I will make Valentine's Day a true 
symphony! The miracle you 
have brought to my heart, I shall bring to 
everyone else as well!!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...... 
Sphera."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"T-That's... Universe's feelings! 
A straight fastball thrown with everything 
she has, chocolate packed with heartfelt 
emotion...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"......! 'Everything she has'... That's 
it...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Fukukitaru. ...Let's go see Taiki. 
There's something I need to confirm."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Howdy! Suzuka and Fukukitaru! 
What brought on this sudden call?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I'd like to ask of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Could you... give me a hug? Just like 
you always do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-san?! Y-You're voluntarily walking 
into the tiger's den?!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You might think it's strange, but... 
there's something I just have to be sure 
of—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Kuh?! Sh-She jumped in right in the 
middle of talking...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I love-love-laaav yooou!! 
Suzukaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second?! 
Are you okay, Suzuka-saaaan?!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, it's fine. Like this... I can feel 
it. Taiki's feelings."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So strong it hurts...! Actually, it 
really hurts...! 
Just how much... she truly loves me."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... what matters is this...!" 
"...... ......"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"T-Taiki-san! 
This is seriously getting dangerous 
now~~!"
